verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS platform like Glama, but nothing in the evidence documents any opt-out control for telemetry or usage tracking. The Gateway's per-call logging is a logging feature, not an opt-out. "Private by default" refers to whether a hosted server is publicly listed, not to tracking, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
